title: Remocn components
description: Remocn (MIT) is a shadcn-style registry of Remotion components: transitions, backgrounds, scenes, text. A component you add with its CLI is a .tsx file, so it plays here as {"kind": "custom", "component": "./path.tsx"}.
reasons: not shipped: add the components you want with the Remocn CLI in your project, then call each one with kind "custom". Wrap it so it reads the SceneProps (r, lf, dur, st); the README shows the five lines.
